newsitem.title: USA: Vista sees results aided by Texas contract.
newsitem.headline: Vista sees results aided by Texas contract.

text.p: Vista Information Solutions Inc said Monday that a decision by the Texas Insurance Commissioner to begin using its Geographic Underwriting System (GUS) product line in the fourth quarter of 1997 should result in a substantial increase in revenues and profits.
The company did not provide specific projections as to the extent of the gains, nor did it put a value on the business.

"Our GUS product line essentially operates on a fixed-cost basis," said Steve Hamilton, Vista's chief financial officer in a statement. "We are pleased with the Texas decision and expect virtually all incremental revenue from Texas will fall to the bottom line."
Vista provides computerized geographic information solutions in the areas of compliance and risk management for the insurance, finance, and environmental engineering industries.
